test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a capital receipt?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Interest received on loans__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Interest received on loans is not a capital receipt.
 
• **Capital receipts **are** **inflows of funds that result in an increase in the** net worth** of a business or organization.
 
• **Revenue receipts** are inflows of funds that result in an increase in the **income **of a business or organization.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Examples of capital receipts include the sale of fixed assets, the sale of equity or debt securities, the receipt of loans or other forms of financing, and the recovery of loans that were previously made.
 
• **Capital receipts** are typically used to finance **long-term investment**s or to fund other capital expenditures, such as the expansion of a business or the acquisition of new assets.
 
• **Revenue receipts**, on the other hand, are typically generated from the ongoing operations of a business and are used to fund the **day-to-day expenses** of the business, such as salaries, rent, and utilities. Examples of revenue receipts include sales of goods or services, rent or lease payments, and interest income.
